items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing changed
items.why: A plan for small businesses now appears, and small sales teams are the customers Acme sells to.
items.text: Added: Microsoft 365 Copilot Business, a plan for businesses with up to 300 users, at $21 per user per month. Removed: nothing. Prices before: $30 per user per month; $360 per user per year. Prices after: $30 per user per month; $21 per user per month; $360 per user per year.

items.title: Gemini adds a connector for a CRM that sales teams use
items.why: It puts Gemini inside the tool Acme's customers work in all day.

sources.name: a trade publication on AI tools

items.text: Google said Gemini for Workspace can now read and update records in a CRM that sales teams use, from Gmail and Docs, without switching tabs. The connector is open to Workspace business customers from today. Microsoft 365 Copilot has offered a connector for the same CRM since the spring.

items.title: GitHub Copilot's release notes add an agent for pull requests
items.why: It is the first Copilot feature that acts on its own, which Acme's roadmap also plans.
items.text: GitHub Copilot can now be given a pull request to review: the new agent reads the change, runs the tests and leaves its comments on its own. It is in public preview for Copilot Business and Copilot Enterprise.

items.title: Gemini API adds a faster model for short answers
items.why: It lowers the cost of the assistant features Acme competes with.

sources.name: a trade publication on AI tools

items.text: Google added a smaller Gemini API model for short answers, priced below its current models and answering in about half the time. It is meant for assistants that answer many small questions a day.

items.title: A Copilot session at Microsoft's partner conference in October
items.why: Partners will hear the small business pitch first there.
items.text: Microsoft will hold a Copilot session at its partner conference in October, on selling Microsoft 365 Copilot to small businesses. Partners can sign up to attend in person or online.
